name: Local Folder Slash Skill Deployment (.claude/skills/)
summary: Extends Claude Code functionality by dropping structured subfolders containing SKILL.md into the workspace .claude/skills directory.
steps: Create or locate the workspace directory in VS Code.
Unzip or copy skill folders into the local .claude/skills/ directory.
Ensure each subfolder contains a SKILL.md file with prompt instructions and frontmatter.
Open Claude Code panel and type / to auto-populate available slash commands.
jarvis_use: Structure local Jarvis Mac operator tools into clean slash-command skills inside .claude/skills.

name: One-Line Curl Remote Skill Package Installer
summary: Installs complete skill suites, helper scripts, and Python dependencies via a single curl shell command executed in terminal.
steps: Host repository containing skills/, scripts/, install.sh, and requirements.txt.
Open terminal inside VS Code.
Run single command curl -fsSL <INSTALL_SCRIPT_URL> | bash to execute the installation script.
Verify skills are automatically downloaded into .claude/skills and Python requirements are installed.
jarvis_use: Deploy new Jarvis skill packages to target local Mac environments using automated single-command shell scripts.

name: Two-Phase Discovery and Parallel Subagent Workflow
summary: Executes a research workflow split into an initial web discovery phase followed by 5 concurrent specialized subagents.
steps: Phase 1 (Discovery): Run centralized web searches for pricing, financial metrics, news, and sector benchmarks.
Phase 2 (Parallel Agent Execution): Simultaneously launch 5 subagents (Technical, Fundamental, Sentiment, Risk, Thesis Synthesis).
Gather outputs from parallel agents into a unified weighted score.
Render composite markdown output and build report artifacts.
jarvis_use: Implement two-phase discovery and parallel subagent execution for multi-faceted system diagnostics or market research.

name: Fast Single-Pass Snapshot Command (/trade-quick)
summary: Performs a fast 60-second snapshot analysis without spawning parallel subagents using a single direct web search pass.
steps: Execute slash command /trade-quick <TICKER> in terminal prompt.
Perform fast targeted web search for spot price, market cap, key news, and 52-week ranges.
Extract bullish factors, bearish factors, and key price levels.
Output condensed status snapshot directly to stdout terminal.
jarvis_use: Provide fast CLI status snapshots for rapid operational checks on Mac OS without heavy agent overhead.

name: CLI-Driven Automated PDF Report Generation
summary: Compiles skill analysis findings and metrics into a formatted PDF report with score gauges and structured tables directly from CLI execution.
steps: Synthesize quantitative scores, bull/bear text, and levels inside Claude Code.
Execute backend Python script from repository scripts directory passing synthesized metrics.
Render circular score gauge, financial metric tables, and catalyst timeline into PDF document.
Open generated PDF side-by-side in VS Code editor for instant review.
jarvis_use: Render executive PDF diagnostic summaries directly from system audit runs for easy reading.

name: Catalyst Impact Timeline Prompt Pattern
summary: Formats upcoming company or system events into a structured impact matrix showing event date, catalyst description, and expected direction/impact magnitude.
steps: Instruct prompt skill to identify upcoming corporate earnings, regulatory dates, or product releases.
Structure findings into a tabular format with columns for Date, Event, Directional Bias (Bullish/Bearish/Neutral), and Impact Level (High/Med/Low).
Incorporate catalyst timeframe into entry and exit timing guidance.
jarvis_use: Format system maintenance or release schedules into structured impact timelines for operational review.

name: Structured Risk Matrix & Position Sizing Prompt Rule
summary: Enforces output formatting rules requiring exact entry zones, stop loss levels, target exits, position sizing percentages, and threat mitigation tables.
steps: Define strict SKILL.md prompt requirements for numerical risk metrics.
Require position sizing allocations scaled across Bull, Base, and Bear cases.
Generate a risk matrix table containing threat description, probability score, impact rating, and explicit mitigation strategy.
jarvis_use: Create fail-safe risk models and mitigation tables before executing high-risk system modifications.

name: Head-to-Head Comparative Slash Command Architecture
summary: Designs slash commands specifically tasked with multi-entity comparison to produce comparative evaluation matrices in CLI.
steps: Define SKILL.md template structured for dual input parameters (e.g. Ticker A vs Ticker B).
Fetch financial metrics and technical indicators simultaneously for both entities.
Render side-by-side valuation comparison, moat strength evaluation, and relative trade signal.
jarvis_use: Compare system resource profiles or service benchmarks side-by-side inside CLI output.
